summary.headline: Astrolabes, Zodiac, and Cosmology
summary.text: Catalog entries for Neapolitan codices 25 and 26. Codex 25 includes astrolabe treatises by John of Alexandria and Pseudo-Aegyptus, twelve astrological rulerships, a brief Selenodromium with zodiac-sign interpretations, and works by Pletho, Aristotle, Gregoras, and others; codex 26 includes teachings by Michael Psellus, astronomical material on the seven planets and twelve zodiac signs, Nicephorus Blemmydes on logic, and Dionysius of Alexandria on the world.
